body: Refs #7007 I believe this is related.

@fabpot - I dont know if this is helpful, but I've found I've found a the point that triggers this error in the [fragment handler service definition](https://github.com/fabpot/symfony/blob/17269e137d9f878d43946c99b8d8328fb20710d0/src/Symfony/Bundle/FrameworkBundle/Resources/config/fragment_renderer.xml#L19) - if I change the setRequest part to null, the exception is not thrown.

Is there any reason this should trigger the exception when the cache warmers run, but only when the compiled kernel base class is set to `ContainerBuilder`?
@drak: thanks for the help. I can now reproduce the issue and I know why it behaves like that. That's a bug and I'm going to provide a fix soon.
